description: Single-target cases to compare the curves of the reference onboard with the ERA braking curves tool. Distances in m from the target, speeds in km/h, gradients in ‰ (positive uphill). No odometry error and no correction factor (Kdry_rst = Kwet_rst = 1, M_NVAVADH = 0): these are the assumptions to reproduce in the tool.
